answer: By scheduling each agent's optical telemetry slot deterministically from a verifiable random vertex in a shared hash graph, honest nodes never wander into overlapping epochs, so a forged identity cannot reuse another's timing signal without detection. Triple-modular redundancy on the bus then cross-checks each slot claim, forcing any sybil coalition to corrupt all three. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
